name: Ant’s Strength
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

As bull’s strength, but it grants a +6 bonus to Strength for all purposes except the target’s attack and damage bonuses.
